metas.name: Aakhri Sawal
metas.description: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

metas.name: Accused
metas.description: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels. Now under a storm of suspicion and scrutiny, her marriage fractures and the truth blurs. Her wife must decide whether to walk away, or fight for the woman the world is turning against.

metas.name: Alpha
metas.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

metas.name: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
metas.description: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

metas.name: Assi
metas.description: When Parima, a school teacher in Delhi, is gang-raped on her way home late at night after an office party, Raavi, a prosecution lawyer, fights tooth and nail to help her get justice. But when eighty sexual assault cases are reported in India every single day, regardless of age group, ethnicity, time, or place,  and only four go to trial, what does justice really mean?

metas.name: Awarapan 2
metas.description: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

metas.name: Azad Bharath
metas.description: Freedom fighter Neera Arya joins India's first women's army founded by Subhas Chandra Bose, highlighting untold stories from India's independence movement and themes of courage and patriotism.

metas.name: Babita Singh Reporting
metas.description: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

metas.name: Baby Do Die Do
metas.description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

metas.name: Bandar
metas.description: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

metas.name: Batwara 1947
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain Fun on the Run
metas.description: Two rival neighbors and their wives embark on a chaotic road trip, encountering two eccentric brothers who transform their journey into a hilarious adventure full of mishaps and unexpected twists.

metas.name: Bhai Tera Star Hai
metas.description: An actor's cricket gambling debt puts him on a deadly deadline. His lie about his sister sets off a catastrophic evening of confused criminals, botched crimes, and pandemonium racing across London.

metas.name: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
metas.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

metas.name: Bharat Desh Hai Mera
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Bhooth Bangla
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Bihu attack
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Blind Game
metas.description: A suspended police officer tracks down a missing fortune and a dangerous secret.

metas.name: Bombay Stories
metas.description: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

metas.name: Border 2
metas.description: Three idealistic soldiers in the Indian army, navy and air force face grueling combat conditions in this film set during the 1971 Indo-Pak war.

metas.name: Chand Mera Dil
metas.description: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

metas.name: Chand Mera Dil
metas.description: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

metas.name: Cocaine
metas.description: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.

metas.name: Cocktail 2
metas.description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

metas.name: Daadi Ki Shaadi
metas.description: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

metas.name: Daayra
metas.description: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

metas.name: Dhamaal 4
metas.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

metas.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
metas.description: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

metas.name: Dial 1975
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Dil Deewana Ho Gaya
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Dilwali Diwali
metas.description: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

metas.name: Do Deewane Seher Mein
metas.description: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while struggling with self-acceptance. As they battle insecurities and societal pressure, their journey takes them from city chaos to mountain serenity.

metas.name: Don't Be Shy
metas.description: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

metas.name: Doosra
metas.description: The 2002 NatWest Final was more than a cricketing victory for India. It was a moment when a nation found its voice, and a young girl found the courage to speak her truth.

metas.name: Drishyam The Conclusion
metas.description: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

metas.name: Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
metas.description: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

metas.name: Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
metas.description: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

metas.name: Ek Din
metas.description: Dino is in love with his colleague Meera but lacks the courage to express his feelings. He finally gets his chance during the company trip. He makes a wish to be with Meera for just one day, and his wish comes true.

metas.name: Everybody Loves Sohrab Handa
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Frame
metas.description: Bound by the profession but divided by their beliefs, two journalists face a life‑changing reckoning.

metas.name: Gajab Raat
metas.description: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

metas.name: Gandhari
metas.description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

metas.name: Ghamasaan
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2
metas.description: A mismatched pair, with a storyline involving a wrestler and a vibrant girl, combining romance, comedy, and drama.

metas.name: Governor
metas.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

metas.name: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
metas.description: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

metas.name: Haiwaan
metas.description: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

metas.name: Hanuman Ansh
metas.description: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

metas.name: Happy Patel Khatarnak Jasoos
metas.description: Chronically unsuccessful MI7 operative Happy Patel is finally assigned a mission in Goa, where he uncovers his Indian roots and must rescue a high-profile scientist from crime lord Mama. Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

metas.name: Haunted 3D Echoes of the Past
metas.description: A man seeks refuge in a remote Indian mountain mansion, fleeing his past. He discovers the house harbors sinister secrets, pain, and terror ready to torment him.

metas.name: Heer Sara
metas.description: Two women embark on a rebellious motorcycle odyssey to Pondicherry - one seeking her lost mother, the other racing to uncover the truth behind a wedding. Laughter, chaos and sisterhood spark freedom, self-worth and eco-conscious living.

metas.name: Ikka
metas.description: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

metas.name: Ikkis
metas.description: Second Lieutenant and India's youngest Param Vir Chakra recipient, Arun Khetarpal, gave his life fighting for his battalion and the country during the 1971 Battle of Basantar. Ikkis also takes a reflective look at the futility of war through the eyes of Khetarpal's father, who visits his ancestral home in Sargodha and Alma Mater for reunion, which now happens to be in post-partition Pakistan, 30 years later.

metas.name: Indian Institute of Zombies
metas.description: At an elite engineering campus, students must survive a sudden zombie outbreak while navigating academic pressures and social hierarchies, blending horror with comedy and biting satire of privilege and competition.

metas.name: Jeena Dil Se
metas.description: A youthful gang's carefree existence spirals into delightful pandemonium after secrets emerge and misunderstandings multiply. Between musical moments and romantic entanglements, they find the courage to live authentically.

metas.name: Jeevan Bheema Yojana
metas.description: Jeevan and Yojna are a couple drowning in debt who hatch an insurance scheme after crossing paths with Bheema, a stranger who bears a striking resemblance to Jeevan - but things spiral out of control when he turns out to be tangled up in a diamond smuggling racket.

metas.name: Johnny Jumper
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Kartavya
metas.description: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

metas.name: Krishnavataram Part 1 The Heart
metas.description: An epic devotional narrative that reimagines the journey of Lord Krishna, tracing his path from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting ways with Radha. As his journey unfolds, it explores his connection with people, his layered personality, and the lessons he imparts about love and life.

metas.name: Last Man in Tower
metas.description: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

metas.name: Little Thomas
metas.description: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

metas.name: Love Lottery
metas.description: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

metas.name: Lust Stories 3
metas.description: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

metas.name: Maa Behen
metas.description: When trouble knocks on her door, a mother and her estranged daughters attempt to cover up a crime in a nosy colony where no secret is safe.

metas.name: Main Actor Nahin Hoon
metas.description: A frustrated actor in Mumbai connects with a retired banker in Frankfurt through an online audition and ends up teaching him acting over video calls. Their sessions unfold across two cities, pushing both to confront buried emotions and truths they have long avoided.

metas.name: Main Vaapas Aaunga
metas.description: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

metas.name: Mardaani 3
metas.description: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.

metas.name: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
metas.description: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

metas.name: Mirzapur: The Movie
metas.description: Akhandanand Tripathi sits on the throne of Mirzapur. Munna Tripathi is heir apparent. Rati Shankar Shukla is the rival from Jaunpur. And, Guddu and Bablu are the two brothers who came like a tornado and changed things irreversibly. And now comes a new claimant in town. Babban Babua, from the desert of Jaisalmer. A ruthless man who is power hungry.

metas.name: Na Jaane Kaun Aa Gaya
metas.description: A love triangle. From Kaushal's breaking world to Tina's silent emotional conflict and Veer's transparent and blunt love, three hearts navigate guilt, longing, and impossible choices.

metas.name: Nakhrewaalii
metas.description: Sumit Mishra cross-dresses as a woman to win over his love interest, Paridhi.

metas.name: Nayi Naveli
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Nukkad Naatak
metas.description: After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

metas.name: O Romeo
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Ohh My Dog
metas.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

metas.name: Om Ka Hari
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: One Two Cha Cha Chaa
metas.description: So, Fuel Up, Gear Up, Level Up and Fasten your seat belts for the wildest and wackiest road trip of all time.

metas.name: Parivarik ManuRanjan
metas.description: Ranjan Dubey, Lucknow's most eligible bachelor, finds his search for a bride taking an unexpected turn when Helen, his charming new househelp, walks into his life. With everyone having an opinion on this unlikely duo, will their companionship blossom into love?

metas.name: Paro Pinaki Ki Kahani
metas.description: A manhole cleaner and vegetable vendor fall in love during secret meetings in a train bathroom. When she stops appearing, he begins a dangerous search to find her.

metas.name: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
metas.description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

metas.name: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
metas.description: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

metas.name: Pooja Meri Jaan
metas.description: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

metas.name: Prahaar
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Prem Keetanu
metas.description: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

metas.name: Rahu Ketu
metas.description: In the magical world of writer Churu Lal Sharma, his unlucky creations Rahu and Ketu spring to life, causing hilarious chaos instead of fighting corruption. When the mischievous Meenu Taxi steals Churu's mystical notebook, the bumbling duo are dragged into absurd adventures that land them in the middle of a drug mafia.

metas.name: Rahun Main Tere Rubaru
metas.description: A vlogger’s dream getaway turns into a deadly fight for survival when he is framed for murder and races against time to save his kidnapped girlfriend.

metas.name: Raja Shivaji
metas.description: Chronicles the rise of young Shivaji Bhonsale, who challenged the might of established empires to found the Maratha kingdom and lay the groundwork for 'Swarajya' (self-rule) during a turbulent period of Indian history.

metas.name: Ramayana Rise of a Legend
metas.description: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

metas.name: Reporting Live
metas.description: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

metas.name: Reporting Live
metas.description: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

metas.name: Sahan
metas.description: Imran Sheikh is a man of dual identities, maintaining a polished, gentlemanly image in public while harboring a volatile nature behind closed doors. His wife, Nusrat, finds herself trapped in a cycle of constant adaptation, struggling to satisfy his increasingly unpredictable and suffocating demands. Despite the growing emotional toll, she remains dedicated to saving their crumbling marriage through sheer endurance. However, her efforts to maintain peace eventually reach a breaking point as the domestic friction escalates. What began as a desperate attempt at harmony soon spirals into a dark and dangerous reality, as things take a sudden, ugly turn.

metas.name: Satluj
metas.description: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

metas.name: Subedaar
metas.description: Haunted by loss and drifting away from his daughter, a retired Subedaar Arjun Maurya’s newly found civilian life is jolted by one reckless act. As old wounds reopen, he must summon the warrior within to face a new kind of war - one that hits too close to his heart.

metas.name: System
metas.description: When Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, meets Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer from a humble background, their lives are thrown into upheaval where power defines truth, blurring the system and raising a question of what justice truly means to them.

metas.name: The Bose Files Sach Ya Sazish
metas.description: Veerali joins Anuj, a researcher obsessed with uncovering the truth behind Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's mysterious disappearance, exposing evidence that challenges the official story of his death.

metas.name: The Great Grand Superhero Aliens Ka Aagman
metas.description: Follows a grandfather and grandson whose relationship transforms through the child's imagination when they encounter aliens.

metas.name: The India Story
metas.description: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

metas.name: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: The Vvaan
metas.description: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that not only do some powers exist beyond logic but he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

metas.name: The Vvaan Force of the Forrest
metas.description: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that not only do some powers exist beyond logic but he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.
